✅ Addressed in commit b7a969e

`sanitize_number` is shared by every amount-sign strategy, but this new sign only makes sense when the `amount` column is itself the signed value (`amount_type_strategy == "signed_amount"`).

For `amount_type_strategy == "custom_column"`, `Import::Row#apply_transaction_signage_convention` (`app/models/import/row.rb`) treats `amount` as an unsigned magnitude and derives the sign purely from the separate type/entity column:
```ruby
if entity_type == selected_identifier
  value * (inflow_treatment == "inflows_positive" ? -1 : 1)
else
  value * (inflow_treatment == "inflows_positive" ? 1 : -1)
end
```
If a custom-column CSV happens to wrap its magnitudes in accounting parentheses (plausible for bank/accounting-style exports that also carry a Debit/Credit column), `sanitize_number` now returns e.g. `"-100"` instead of `"100"`, and this multiplication is applied on top of that, flipping the final sign relative to pre-PR behavior for exactly the rows whose `entity_type` matches the inflow identifier.

`YnabImport#signed_csv_amount` (`app/models/ynab_import.rb`) has the same exposure: it calls `sanitize_number` separately on the `Inflow`/`Outflow` columns and does `inflow - outflow.abs`, assuming both are non-negative magnitudes. A parenthesized value in either column now feeds a negative number into that subtraction instead of the stripped positive it got before this change.

Neither path is covered by the new tests (which only exercise the default `signed_amount` strategy), so this regression wouldn't be caught by `bin/rails test`. Consider only applying the parens-to-negative conversion when the caller actually wants a signed amount (e.g. gate it in `Import::Row#signed_amount`/`apply_transaction_signage_convention` for `custom_column`, and in `YnabImport#signed_csv_amount` take `.abs` of the inflow/outflow values after sanitizing), rather than inside the shared `sanitize_number` helper.

Good catch, thanks. `sanitize_number` is shared, so the parentheses-to-negative conversion is now opt-in (`parentheses_negative:`). It is passed only for the generic amount column when `amount_type_strategy` is not `custom_column`, and for YNAB's single signed Amount column (so account-balance imports, where the column is itself signed, keep the conversion). The custom-column amount and YNAB Inflow/Outflow keep treating parenthesized values as magnitudes, as before the PR. Added tests for both paths (custom_column with "(1,234.56)" stays 1234.56; a parenthesized YNAB Inflow stays income); both fail without the change. Pushed as b7a969e2.
